title: Item:Tome of Universal Enhancement
wikitext:
{{TomeTOC}}

[[Tome]]s of Universal Enhancement grant extra [[Action Point]]s that can be used in universal [[enhancements]] trees, such as [[Harper Agent enhancements]].

[[File:Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Sharn).png|right|400px]][[File:Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Morgrave).png|right|400px]][[File:Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Lamordia).png|right|400px]][[File:Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Demogorgon).png|right|400px]]

== Description ==

Entwined with the words of this thick book is a powerful magical effect that grants a permanent +1 inherent bonus to Universal Enhancement Points.

This effect will not stack with other Tomes of Universal Enhancement (of the same source) but will with Tomes of Universal Enhancement from other sources.

== Sources ==

* '''Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Sharn)''' was introduced with [[Masterminds of Sharn]] expansion. The ultimate bundle grants a tome to each character. In September 2019, the tome became available in the [[DDO Store]] for 3495 DP.
* '''Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Morgrave)''' was introduced with [[Vecna Unleashed]] expansion. The ultimate bundle grants a tome to each character. In March 2024, the tome became available in the DDO Store for 3495 DP.
* '''Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Lamordia)''' was introduced with [[The Chill of Ravenloft]] expansion. The ultimate bundle grants a tome to each character. In January 2026, the tome became available in the DDO Store for 2995 DP.
* '''Tome of Universal Enhancement +1 (Demogorgon)''' was introduced with the [[Terror of Demogorgon]] expansion. The ultimate bundle grants a tome to each character. In January 2027, the tome became available in the DDO Store for 3495 DP.

== Notes ==

* Unlike [[Item:Tome of Enhancement (Racial)|Tome of Enhancement (Racial)]], this tome is *NOT* displayed in the character sheet > feats > special feats. To check if the tome was applied, check the enhancement page.
* This tome is {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, so you must be sure you don't have it already on the toon you buy it with (and it's the toon you want to use it on).
